description: AICEK marketplace seed. Each entry is a real, verified, permissively-licensed tool for AI coding agents. Consumed by `aicek init` (PRD Stage 3). Canonical source is packages/core/src/registry.ts; this file is generated from it and kept in sync by a test.

entries.name: OpenSpec
entries.token_note: Specs are read on demand, not loaded every session — minimal always-on cost.
entries.health_impact: Improves Routing Correctness: moves planning/spec content out of CLAUDE.md into on-demand spec files.

entries.name: Caveman
entries.token_note: Compresses instructions/prompts; author reports ~65% token reduction.
entries.health_impact: Boosts Context Economy by shrinking always-on instruction size. AICEK can recommend it when CLAUDE.md is over budget.

entries.name: Graphify
entries.token_note: Builds a code graph so only relevant context is retrieved, instead of dumping files.
entries.health_impact: Improves Context Economy: targeted retrieval reduces context bloat per session.

entries.name: Impeccable
entries.token_note: A suite of on-demand design skills (invoked by description); no always-on context cost.
entries.health_impact: Adds on-demand Skills (good Routing Correctness) with no Context Economy penalty.

entries.name: Context7
entries.token_note: Fetches up-to-date library docs on demand via MCP, instead of pasting docs into context.
entries.health_impact: Improves Redundancy & Routing: replaces stale pasted docs with an on-demand MCP capability.

entries.name: Claude SEO
entries.token_note: 25 sub-skills + 18 sub-agents, loaded on demand rather than always-on.
entries.health_impact: On-demand skill bundle. Watch Skill Effectiveness — many sub-skills means descriptions must be sharp to actually activate.

entries.name: Code Review Skill
entries.token_note: On-demand review skill; loaded only when a review is requested.
entries.health_impact: On-demand Skill with good Routing Correctness; no always-on cost.
